spans.s:
हल् 1. हल्, cl. 1. P. हलति, जहाल, अहा-
लीत्, &c., to plough, make furrows.

हल् 2. हल्, m. n. (in Pāṇini's system) a
technical expression for all the consonants; any con-
sonant.
—हल्-अन्त, अस्, आ, अम्, ending in a con-
sonant.

हल, अम्, n. a plough; ugliness, deformity, =
वैरूप्य; (आ), f. the earth; water; spirituous
liquor, wine.
—हल-धर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, plough-
holding, having a plough; (अस्), m. a ploughman;
epithet of Bala-rāma (as bearing a peculiar weapon
shaped like a ploughshare; cf. सीर-पाणि).
—हल-
भूति, इस्, f. agriculture, husbandry.
—हल-भृत्,
त्, त्, त्, plough-holding, possessing a plough; (त्), m.
a ploughman; Bala-rāma; [cf. सीर-भृत्.]
—हल-
भृति, इस्, f. ploughing, agriculture, husbandry;
(इस्), m., N. of a Muni (= उप-वर्ष, कृत-कोटि,
अ-याचित).
—हल-मुखी, f. a kind of metre.
—हल-राक्ष, अम्, n. a kind of shrub (=
आहुल्य).
—हल-हति, इस्, f. ‘plough-striking,’
ploughing, furrowing.
—हलायुध (˚ल-आय्˚), अस्,
m. ‘plough-weaponed,’ Bala-rāma, (see above); N.
of a poet (son of Dhanañ-jaya); of the author of
the Brāhmaṇa-sarvasva; of the author of the Purāṇa-
sarvasva; of the author of the Abhidhāna-ratnamālā
lexicon.

हला हला, f. a female friend, (see also
हला under हल); (हला), ind. a vocative particle
used in addressing a female friend who is an equal
(in theatrical language).

हाल हाल, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. हल् or fr. हल),
a plough; N. of Bala-rāma (as bearing a weapon
shaped like a ploughshare, see हल-धर); N. of
Śālivāhana; of a king; (आ), f. spirituous liquor,
wine, the spirituous juice of the palm; (ई), f. a
wife's younger sister.
—हाल-भृत्, m. epithet of
Bala-rāma (= हल-भृत्).
—हालास्य-माहात्म्य
(˚ल-आस्˚), अम्, n., N. of a part of the Skanda-Purāṇa.

हलय, Nom. P. हलयति, &c., to plough (=
हलिं गृह्णाति, Vopa-deva
XXI. 17

हलाह, अस्, m. a horse of a mixed or variegated
colour, (also read हालाह.)

हालाह, अस्, m. a spotted or piebald horse (accord-
ing to some).

हलि, इस्, m. a large plough, ploughshare (=
जित्या, Vopa-deva
XXVI. 20

; = वृहद्-धल, q. v.);
a furrow (according to some); agriculture.
हली, f. the plant Kali-kārī, q. v.

हलीषा, f. (probably fr. हल + ईषा), = लाङ्ग-
लीषा, the handle of a plough.

हल्लीश हल्लीश, अम्, n. one of the eighteen
Upa-rūpakas or minor dramatic entertainments (de-
scribed as a piece in one act, consisting chiefly of
singing and dancing by one male and seven, eight,
or ten female performers), a ballet; a circular dance
(performed by women).
हल्लीष, हल्लीषक, = हल्लीश above.
हल्लीस, हल्लीसक, = हल्लीश above.

हल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be ploughed or tilled,
arable; belonging to or proceeding from ugliness or
[]
deformity, ugly; (आ), f. a multitude of ploughs;
(अम्), n. a ploughed field, arable land; ugliness; de-
formity.
हलद्दी हलद्दी, f. turmeric (= हरिद्रा).

हलहला हल-हला (an imitative sound),
halloo, hallooing.
—हलहला-शब्द, अस्, m. shout-
ing Hala-halā, hallooing, shout, outcry, tumult.

हलाहल हलाहल, अस्, अम्, m. n. (= हाल-
हल, q. v., sometimes also written हलहल, and
said to be fr. rt. 1. हल्), a sort of deadly poison [cf.
कालकूट at p. 226, col. 2]; (अस्), m. a kind of
snake (= ब्रह्म-सर्प); a Jaina or Bauddha sage;
a sort of lizard or newt.

हालहल, अम्, n. (= हलाहल, q. v.), a sort of
deadly poison (produced at the churning of the
ocean by the gods and demons); any poison or
venom.
हालहाल, अम्, n. the above poison.

हालाहल, अस्, m. a sort of worm or insect; a
kind of lizard or newt; (आ), f. a small mouse; (ई),
f. spirituous liquor, wine; (अम्), n. the above
deadly poison or any poison, venom; spirituous
liquor.
—हालाहल-धर, अस्, m. ‘having venom,’
a small black snake.

हलीन हलीन, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 1.
हल्), the Teak tree (= शाक).

हलीमक 1. हलीमक, अम्, n. (probably con-
nected with 1. हरिमन् at p. 1167, col. 2), a sort
of jaundice, paleness or yellowness of skin.
हलुआण हलुआण or हलूआण, N. of a place.
हल्लक हल्लक, अम्, n. the red lotus.

हालक हालक, अस्, m. (connected with
हरिक), a horse of a yellowish brown or tawny
colour.

हल्लन हल्लन, अम्, n. rolling or tossing
about, rolling about in sleep.

हल्लीशक, अस्, m. dancing in a ring (as performed
by women).

हालिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to
ploughing or a plough, agricultural; (अस्), m. a
ploughman, ploughboy, agriculturist.
हालिनी, f. a sort of large house-lizard.
हालु, उस्, m. (according to Uṇādi-s.

. fr. rt.
1. हल्), a tooth (= दन्त).
हालेय, अस्, m., N. of a king.
